issues.problem: av-mou-mada explain: 'not yet takes the ている form' stated without exception; mechanical use yields odd forms for stative verbs and adjectives (まだ分からない, まだ寒くない).
issues.action: Limited the rule to action verbs and added the stative/adjective exception.

issues.problem: av-time mistake: 'すぐ母から電話がありました' is not plainly wrong (すぐ can describe something that happened right after an earlier event).
issues.action: Replaced with さっき戻ります → すぐ戻ります (さっき cannot point to the future).

issues.problem: av-time example English 'I waited all along' is unidiomatic.
issues.action: Changed to 'I waited and waited, but in the end he never came.'

issues.problem: Mistake note and contrast said ても clauses never take もし; もし〜ても is attested standard Japanese.
issues.action: Reworded the mistake note (もし cannot mean 'however much'; use いくら / どんなに), softened contrast to 'normally', and added a parenthetical in explain Q4.

issues.problem: Example 田中さんならきっと合格するでしょう translated without the なら ('Mr Tanaka is sure to pass').
issues.action: Changed to 'Knowing Mr Tanaka, he is sure to pass.'
